jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer – Human Capital (F81CD27)
jobs.description:
Referment is working with a global investment and technology firm to find a senior engineer who will lead practical AI initiatives within its people function. You will work across human capital, product management and software engineering to turn talent-related business needs into useful, governed AI solutions.

The remit combines hands-on prototyping with technical direction. You will build in Python, guide integration into production products, evaluate outcomes and help colleagues make informed choices as models and tooling evolve.

The Role

Identify high-value AI use cases with internal stakeholders and translate them into well-scoped technical solutions.
Design and deliver Python prototypes, then partner with product and engineering teams to integrate successful features.
Evaluate AI tools through user feedback and outcome monitoring, recommending improvements.
Set technical direction across models, tooling, prompt design, retrieval and agentic approaches.
Mentor junior colleagues and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

A bachelor's degree and at least six years' experience across human capital, data science or technology development, including exposure to AI.
Strong Python and data skills, with practical familiarity with LLMs, RAG, agentic architectures and modern AI development tools.
Knowledge of statistical methods; social-science research experience is useful.
Evidence of delivering across ambiguous, cross-functional workstreams and influencing stakeholders.
Management experience is preferred rather than essential.

This could suit an applied AI or data-science leader who enjoys building prototypes while shaping how a people-focused product portfolio adopts AI responsibly.

jobs.title: Senior System Software Engineer, Agentic Retrieval
jobs.description:
NVIDIA's technology is at the heart of the AI revolution, touching people across the planet by powering everything from self-driving cars, robotics, co-pilots and more. Join us at the forefront of technological advancement in intelligent assistants and information retrieval. NVIDIA is looking for a System Software Engineer - Agentic Retrieval to develop pipelines for indexing and querying multi-modal content. We are looking for someone with a passion for working with the world's most challenging problems in Generative AI, LLM, VLLM, and Agentic Retrieval spaces using our innovative hardware and software platforms. You will develop tools for building powerful, flexible, multi-modal retrievers and agents driven by Large Language Models(LLM) thereby improving the experience of millions of customers. If you're creative & passionate about solving real world conversational AI problems, come join us.

This role is pivotal in accelerating containerized pipelines for high quality multi-modal datasets and providing best-in-class retrieval efficacy. The day-to-day focus is on developing efficient, scalable systems for deduplicating, filtering, and classifying training corpora for tailored models that enhance off-the-shelf capabilities. Fundamental to these efforts are iterative testing and improvement in system cost, speed, & accuracy through micro-optimization, prompt engineering, fine tuning, and applying new research. The ideal candidate believes in craftsmanship whereby they release early and often to obtain feedback while keeping the long-term vision alive! They are comfortable objectively evaluating the latest AI models and frameworks with an eye towards acceleration and capability enhancement.

What You'll Be Doing

Develop and optimize Rust-based data processing frameworks, ensuring efficient handling of large datasets on GPU-accelerated environments, vital for LLM training.
Lead development and iterative optimization of components for Agentic Retrieval pipelines, ensuring they demonstrate GPU acceleration & the best performing models for improved TCO.
Collaborate with teams of LLM & ML researchers in the development of full-stack, GPU-accelerated data preparation pipelines for multimodal models Implement benchmarking, profiling, and optimization of innovative algorithms in Python in various system architectures, specifically targeting LLM applications.
Work closely with diverse teams to understand requirements, build & evaluate POCs, and develop roadmaps for production level tools and library features within the growing LLM ecosystem.
Build amazing products to improve employee productivity using Gen-AI & Co-pilot experiences!
Develop integrated systems enabling unified experience across applications and driving insights for end-to-end user experience.
Help build and maintain our Continuous Delivery pipeline with the goal of moving changes to production faster and safer, while ensuring key operational standards.
Provide peer reviews to other specialists including feedback on performance, scalability, and correctness and actively contribute to the adoption of frameworks, standards, and new technologies

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
6+ years of experience in a similar or related role
Experience delivering software in a cloud context and is familiar with the patterns and process of managing cloud infrastructure
Knowledge of MLOps technologies such as Docker-Compose, Containers, Kubernetes, data center deployments etc
Excellent in-depth hands-on understanding of NLP, LLM, VLM, Generative AI, and Agentic Retrieval workflows
Self-starter with a passion for growth, enthusiasm for continuous learning and sharing findings across the team
Outstanding communication skills for distilling sophisticated topics down to understandable, impactful conclusions..
Ability to work successfully with multi-functional teams, principals, and architects. Coordinates optimally across organizational boundaries and geographies.

If you are passionate about technology, have a proven track record in system software engineering, and are eager to make a significant impact in the industry, we would love to hear from you. Join us at NVIDIA and help us craft the future of visual computing!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 6, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer / Technical Co-Founder — Mobile, Computer Vision & Spatial Systems
jobs.description:
Company Description
Captchr is an early-stage startup based in San Francisco. Two trillion photos are taken every year, and 94% of them on smartphones. Instagram and Snapchat focus on sharing and spreading that content. We focus on a different problem: Captchr is building a platform that helps people discover photos and videos of themselves that others have captured . The company is focused on closing the gap between the vast amount of recorded footage and the people who appear in it, ensuring that consent and privacy remain core principles. Captchr aims to create a seamless experience where individuals can be seen and find meaningful media from their lives more easily.
Where we are

We have a working demo prototype. The next step is to develop it into a real product, then take it to investors to raise our first round. As a co-founder, you would help build that version and join the fundraising conversations.
Role Description
You will:
Build and iterate on Captchr's mobile application and core product experience.
Develop and evaluate computer-vision approaches for understanding captured images and video.
Explore spatial, location, proximity, and device-sensor technologies relevant to the product.
Design the backend systems and APIs connecting mobile clients, media, and users.
Prototype different technical approaches and test them in real-world environments.
Optimize for accuracy, latency, scalability, battery consumption, privacy, and security.
Help define Captchr's technical architecture and technology stack.
Work closely on product decisions involving consent, privacy, safety, and user experience.
Help build the engineering team and culture as the company grows.
Participate in technical discussions with future investors, partners, and hires.

Qualifications

We're not expecting one person to be an expert in every technology below. We're looking for a strong builder with deep experience in some
of these areas and the ability to learn and experiment across the others.
Strong mobile engineering experience with iOS and/or Android
, ideally involving cameras, media, sensors, or real-time experiences.
Experience with computer vision / machine learning
, such as image and video processing, detection, tracking, matching, or visual understanding.
Familiarity with frameworks such as OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow
, or equivalent technologies.
Experience or strong interest in geolocation, proximity, device orientation, sensor fusion, AR/spatial computing, mapping, or related systems
.
Ability to design and build backend services, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
Strong understanding of performance, security, privacy, and scalable system design.
Product-minded engineering approach—you think about the person using the technology, not only the technology itself.
Comfortable working in an early-stage environment where the answer isn't already known.
Strong communication skills and willingness to challenge assumptions, prototype alternatives, and help shape the company.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience

You Might Be Especially Excited About Captchr If... You like photography.
You like building mobile products that interact with the real world
, not just another screen.
You find computer vision, cameras, spatial computing, and emerging mobile technologies interesting.
And when somebody presents you with a difficult technical problem, your first reaction is:
“Let's figure out how to make it work.”

The Opportunity Captchr is pre-launch and early-stage.
This is a co-founder opportunity with meaningful equity
, initially equity-based rather than a conventional salaried engineering position.
We're looking for someone who wants to help take Captchr from prototype → product → users → fundraising → company.

San Francisco / Bay Area preferred.
